title: Version Controlling & Syncing Across Resumes - Resume Builder - Content Management & Career History
description:
LIKE & SUBSCRIBE for you more Resume, Job Search & Career Growth content!

In this video, we dive deep into the world of version controlling your resumes using Teal!  Whether you have multiple resumes for different job applications or just want to stay organized, we’ll explore the incredible features that make managing your resumes a breeze. Get ready to simplify the way you handle resume updates and ensure consistency across your job applications!

What We Will Cover:
- How to create and duplicate multiple resumes
- The significance of the "Save To All Resumes" feature 
- When to edit existing bullets versus creating new ones
- Syncing updates between resumes
- Handling version changes and updates effectively
- Smart strategies for maintaining your career history across various resumes

Questions Answered in This Video:
- How do I manage multiple resumes within Teal?
- What does the "Save To All Resumes" option do?
- When should I edit a bullet vs. creating a new bullet?
- How can I sync changes across different resumes?
- What happens to my career history when I create a new resume?
- How do I make local modifications without affecting all resumes?
